content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is a sovereign commerce stack — a combination of tools that give you full control over your digital product sales. It’s built on Cloudflare Workers, a serverless platform that executes code without servers, and integrates with NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. The webhook architecture ensures instant payment verification and product delivery. USDT on Tron and Solana networks keep transaction fees under $0.10. This stack bypasses platform restrictions and payout delays, giving you direct access to your earnings in any currency, including naira, cedis, or shillings via P2P exchanges.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, processing incoming payment webhooks from NOWPayments. When a buyer sends USDT or Solana, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook to your Worker. The Worker checks the payment status, updates your Supabase or Google Sheets order database, and triggers product delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The entire process takes under 60 seconds. Transaction fees on Tron and Solana are negligible, and the architecture is designed to scale without additional costs.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, or templates and face payout delays or currency conversion issues, this architecture solves your problem. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. After deployment, you control everything — no platform can restrict your access or delay your payouts. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, fully configured and tested.
USDT on Tron costs under $0.10 per transaction — ideal for digital product sales.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers provide the backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver products. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies. USDT on Tron and Solana are recommended for their low transaction fees. The stack is email-ready with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured for secure communication. Each component is free or low-cost, and the entire stack is designed for lifetime ownership, not recurring subscriptions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by mapping your product flow: payment → verification → delivery. Choose USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. Set up NOWPayments and configure the webhook to your Cloudflare Worker. Use Supabase for order storage and Google Drive for file delivery. Test end-to-end before going live. If you prefer a done-for-you solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and 30-day support. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT payments on Tron arrive in under 60 seconds, with network fees under $0.10 per transaction. Solana payments are even faster, with fees averaging fractions of a cent. Both networks are ideal for digital product sales, as they eliminate the payout delays and high fees associated with PayPal. After payment confirmation, the product is delivered instantly, and you can convert funds to local currency via P2P exchanges like Binance or Patricia.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy a Cloudflare Worker to handle payment verification and product delivery. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data. Upload products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test the entire flow with a test payment. If you prefer a done-for-you solution, purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
